# Lucas Christian

> Lucas Christian is a Staff Security Engineer in Enterprise Security at Databricks, based in the Greater Seattle Area. This is his personal professional website and security writing archive.

His focus areas include enterprise endpoint security and Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR), SaaS Security Posture Management (SSPM), zero-trust access, security automation, architecture reviews, and technical mentoring. He holds CISSP and OSCP certifications. His experience includes Databricks, Uber, and Susquehanna International Group (SIG).

These articles document historical research and CTF work; their publication dates do not represent current employment or recently reviewed product guidance.
